format: ogg/vorbis q5; mono for positional sfx, stereo for music + ambience

conventions.gain: 'gain' is a linear multiplier <= 1 that balances loudness within and across categories; game master gain on top
conventions.loops: loop=true files are exact-length seamless loops: loopStart=0, loopEnd=duration; use AudioBufferSourceNode.loop=true
conventions.variations: files list one file per variation; pick randomly, never same twice in a row, pitch +-4%
conventions.engines: see 'engines': stage loops recorded at fixed RPM; crossfade neighbours (equal power) and set playbackRate = currentRPM / stageRPM (0.75..1.35)
